SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b; require(c >= a); pure
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b; pure
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b); pure
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b; pure
Owned() constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged control
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: sets newOwner
acceptOwnership() public: require(msg.sender == newOwner); moves owner to newOwner
Globglogabgalab() constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-mints the whole supply to a fixed address
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner]
transfer(address to, uint tokens): safeSub on sender balance, safeAdd on recipient balance, emits Transfer
approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], emits Approval (no double-spend check)
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): safeSub of balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd of balances[to]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): stores allowance then invokes external approveAndCallFallBack callback
function () public payable: unconditionally reverts, refuses Ether
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner: external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens)
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used for ownership, allowances and balance debits
